movie: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
review:
A well-directed feel-good movie. We follow Ben Stiller’s character, Walter Mitty, as he goes on an ordinary and full of daydreams life at first, to a more lively adventure later.

The acting and some CGI scenes can be a bit over the top at first, but I think it ends up fitting with the plot and what the movie is trying to show.
